messages:
adrian: FYI — seeing increased 5xxs on EU1 ingress since ~08:42 UTC after the header-parsing change. Affected endpoint: POST /v1/generate (hosted). Impact: error rate peaked ~12% for EU-hosted traffic (~1.5k rps). Rolling back the header-parser change now.

deploy-bot: rollback job started by adrian at 08:46 UTC — job #45678.

sasha: Which customers hit? Any enterprise/VIP impact we should escalate?

adrian: Early signal mostly from high-volume embedding customers routing through eu1. No SLA breaches reported so far, but volume could push some customers into degraded experience. Dashboard: https://internal.redwood/status/ingress-eu1 (internal).

mira: ETA on rollback completing?

deploy-bot: rollback to v2.3.1 -> completed at 08:50 UTC on all eu1 nodes.

adrian: Confirming error rate back down to ~0.8% and latency trending normal. Keeping routing fallback active for another 10m while we monitor.

kai: Nice. Can we get a one-paragraph customer-facing blurb? I can post to #customer-success once we have confirmation.

adrian: I'll draft. Postmortem owner: adrian, co-owner: sasha. Runbook referenced: /runbooks/ingress-header-regression. Commands used: ```kubectl rollout undo deployment/ingress-proxy -n eu1 --to-revision=42``` 

opsbot: Incident created INC-2026-0345. Pagers notified.

sasha: +1. I'll prepare a short status note for customers (what happened, what we did, next steps) and post in ~15m.

adrian: Thanks all. Keeping channel open for any regressions. :white_check_mark: :rotating_light:

(automated note) metrics link: https://internal.redwood/metrics/ingress-eu1?window=15m
